name: Review Google Play feedback and developer replies with Apify and Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Review app feedback and public replies

For app and support teams reviewing Google Play feedback by rating, app version and public developer reply.

### How it works
1. Read one bounded review window for a known app, country and language.
2. Verify coverage and scan charges; keep scan receipts out of your feedback rows.
3. Update one Sheet row per review. Filter reviewAction for low ratings, check appVersion and read the original review before deciding what to do.

### Setup
- [ ] Select Apify Header Auth on all five HTTP nodes: Authorization with Bearer followed by your token.
- [ ] Connect Google Sheets OAuth2 on Upsert review register.
- [ ] Create the **App Feedback** tab and import the exact [header CSV](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bulatovicluka1989-rgb/luminar-apify-examples/main/actors/google-play-reviews-change-monitor/n8n-feedback-review/sheet-header.csv). Set spreadsheetId.
- [ ] Set appId, country, language and sort in Review settings. maximumResults allows 1–100 review slots, never a promised minimum.

### Reading repeated results
Run manually and sequentially. Existing keys update; unobserved older rows remain, so check observedAt. Empty results add no rows.

The template is free; Apify runs are paid. The $1 cap is a ceiling, not a run price. Repeats may be charged again. [Setup guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bulatovicluka1989-rgb/luminar-apify-examples/main/actors/google-play-reviews-change-monitor/n8n-feedback-review/README.md).

## 1. Choose an app and review window
Enter appId, country, language and sort. Add spreadsheetId and import the App Feedback header. Helpful reviews are the default; newest samples can change between runs.

## 2. Collect one paid review window
Run Google Play once starts the scan. The lower branch waits on the same run; it never starts another paid scan automatically.

## 3. Separate reviews from scan receipts
Verify one-app coverage, Dataset counts and settled batch charges. Scan receipts prove paid capacity and never become feedback rows. CAPPED means a limited window; source failures stop delivery.

## 4. Review ratings and public replies
Upsert by app, locale, sort and reviewId. Filter reviewAction for ratings 1–2, then read appVersion and developerReplyText. Missing replies remain unobserved; this template posts no replies.
